runner_hardening.reason: Windows PowerShell Start-Process timed wrapper returned a null ExitCode after a completed Godot parser process, causing a false failure; the earlier recursive parent-runner chain could also stall for excessive time
runner_hardening.direct_parent_regression: P4.4 runner executes the committed P4.3 acceptance test directly and verifies the accepted aggregate instead of recursively invoking all ancestor runners
runner_hardening.process_api: System.Diagnostics.Process with redirected stdout/stderr ReadToEndAsync tasks and exit code read from the live process handle after WaitForExit
runner_hardening.timeout_behavior: fail closed and terminate the Godot process tree with taskkill
runner_hardening.expected_effect: bounded reliable gate runtime on Windows PowerShell without weakening P4.3 semantic parent regression

contract.production_ownership: P4.4 defines the first production-owned ecology region snapshot envelope; P3.8 checkpoint bytes remain research/reference ancestry only
contract.snapshot_identity: snapshot_hash binds accepted P4.3 parent, region id, clock/catch-up/region hashes, ecology generation and explicit observed horizon
contract.serialization: validated snapshots serialize to deterministic typed bytes using a fixed magic header, format_version, payload SHA-256, payload byte count and snapshot hash
contract.restore: deserialization restores the exact typed P4.3 catch-up state and therefore exact RegionState/Clock identities without reading wall clock
contract.restart_continuity: pending backlog and fractional observed horizon survive serialize/load/restore and converge to the same accepted P4.3 state as uninterrupted advancement
contract.integrity: wrong magic, unsupported format version, size mismatch, checksum mismatch, trailing/truncated bytes, nested tamper and derived-field tamper fail closed
contract.migration_boundary: P4.4 is production format version 1; current-format migration is identity, and no fictional migration from P3.8 or unknown versions is authorized
contract.file_io: save_file/load_file own production snapshot bytes, file SHA reporting and exact snapshot restoration

targeted_exact_attached_godot_evidence.boundary_note: targeted runtime uses the deterministic P3 persistence stub only to exercise P4.1/P4.2/P4.3/P4.4 interfaces; it is not lifecycle acceptance evidence

full_chain_expected.file_sha_policy: must be a 64-hex SHA-256 and fresh-process output must be byte-identical; kernel/test blob pins freeze the exact codec implementation
